subheader.text: Do you know what condensation looks like?

subpoints.text: Think about what happens when you take a hot shower. Water from the shower can evaporate into water vapor. This water vapor makes the bathroom air feel damp.
When water vapor hits the cool surface of the bathroom mirror, it can condense. The water vapor condenses into tiny liquid water droplets. These water droplets make the mirror foggy.

contents.text: A gas changes into a liquid by condensing. The water droplets that form on the outside of a cold drink are caused by water vapor condensing.
